en.topic_title: Police arrest 2 over HK$900K street scam involving fake lockout stories
en.topic_summary:
Police have arrested two people after two victims lost a combined HK$900,000 to a scammer claiming to be locked out of their home and in need of money for a locksmith.



The Hong Kong Police Force emblem. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP.



Police said officers received a report from a Tuen Mun resident on Monday, saying she was approached by a woman on the street who said she had forgotten her keys.
